column1: Table 1 Passive sound-localization thresholds (minimum audible angles) of bats

* Includes only thresholds obtained using procedures that do not permit echolocation to contribute to performance. Accordingly, thresholds of obstacle avoidance and flying toward a sound-emitting prey are not included.
** This genus of Pteropodidae is believed to have evolved from non-echolocating species and to have secondarily developed echolocation using double tongue clicks for orientation in caves.
